'''Rockwu''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Rockfu]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Rockong]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "With newly learned staff techniques, Rockwu has the perfect answer to those pesky [[Zobos]]. The Tatari around here are Rockwu's to mess with and Rockwu's alone. Who do those Zobos think they are?"

Rockwu is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A brown chimpanzee that stands on its hind legs and wields a staff that resembles a stone pillar. Its face, limbs, and tail are light brown, and it has orange markings on its chin, ears, hands, and eyes. It has black sclera with yellow pupils.

Rockwu's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces brown with blue and green, and light brown becomes white. 

== Evolution Trial ==
Rockwu's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Rockong]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 120 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x7200 fertilizer).
* Own 24-star Rock Tatari x3.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Adored with a platinum crown and wielding a will-bound iron staff, Rockwu is the legendary king of monkeys alright!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Having secretly learned a staff technique from somewhere, Rockwu is now a martial master. Still, old habits die hard, so Rockwu often swing around wildly even when there is no fight to join."

==Strategy==
